actions.newValue: In this near-future drama by Noga Flaishon, a tech firm packages people's memories as VR experiences. Employee Rachel sees a chance to preserve the testimony of her grandmother Rivka, soon to be the last living Holocaust survivor, and the project turns into a family fight over ownership, ethics and legacy. Tangram Theatre Company stage the London premiere, directed by Daniel Goldman, with Beverley Klein as Rivka.

Cherubini's opera retells Euripides' tragedy. Jilted by Giasone (Jason), who is about to marry Glauce, the princess of Corinth, the sorceress Medea demands him back, then sends the bride a poisoned gift and carries out her revenge on their children. David McVicar directs the Met production, with Sonya Yoncheva in the title role and Michael Spyres as Giasone.
